item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 6 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 6 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 3:00 PM, 21 October 2026(Wednesday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Bataan (Dinalupihan, Hermosa, and Morong), Batangas (Santo Tomas, Tanauan, Malvar, Balete, Mataasnakahoy, Lipa, Mabini, Bauan, San Luis, Taal, Santa Teresita, Alitagtag, Agoncillo, San Nicolas, Lemery, Batangas City, Cuenca, San Jose, San Pascual, and Ibaan), Laguna (Santa Maria, Mabitac, Siniloan, Famy, Kalayaan, Lumban, Cavinti, Luisiana, Pagsanjan, Majayjay, San Pablo, and Alaminos), Metro Manila (Quezon City, Mandaluyong, Taguig, Makati, Pasig, San Juan, Pateros, Marikina, Manila, Caloocan, Malabon, Valenzuela, and Navotas), Pampanga (Porac and Floridablanca), Quezon (Real, Tayabas, Lucena, Pagbilao, Atimonan, Padre Burgos, Agdangan, Dolores, Candelaria, Tiaong, Mulanay, San Andres, San Francisco, San Narciso, and San Antonio), Rizal (Tanay, Pililla, Jala-Jala, Antipolo, San Mateo, Binangonan, Morong, Teresa, Baras, and Cardona), Tarlac (Mayantoc, Capas, and Bamban), and Zambales (Masinloc, Palauig, Cabangan, San Marcelino, Subic, Castillejos, and Olongapo) within the next 2 hours.

Heavy to intense rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are affecting Batangas (San Juan, Rosario, Taysan, Lobo, and Padre Garcia), Laguna (Pakil, Pangil, and Paete), Quezon (Mauban, Sampaloc, Lucban, and Sariaya), Rizal (Taytay, Angono, and Cainta), Tarlac (San Jose), and Zambales (Botolan and Iba) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
